pages.text: $(item)Electric Shock Device$() — attach the shock unit to your target; it stays active for a whole day (20 minutes). Once it's on... you get to press the button.

$(item)Electric Shock Controller$() — right-click to press the button, and everyone within 16 blocks wearing a shock device jumps sky-high amid thunder and sparks!«N-no! Don't turn it up any higher♡ I can't take it♡»

pages.title: A Gentle Reminder
pages.text: $4Shock play has risks — play in moderation!$()$(br2)It's only 0.2 points of magic damage in-game, but watching them leap straight up looks really silly... and adorable, meow~
